summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash warm starts reuse the measured KV budget
compatibility: No user action required. After changing an environment variable that affects GPU memory, start once with VLLM_ENABLE_STARTUP_PLAN=0 or set KV_CACHE_MEMORY_BYTES.
details: The ds4-flash profile enables vLLM's startup plan. The first start records the KV budget; later starts with the same configuration skip the CUDA-graph memory estimation pass, which re-prepares every B12X attention plan: about 45-50 s less on TP2.
A plan is refused when free GPU memory is lower than when it was recorded, and it is keyed by the vLLM configuration, device and versions.
